run.name: Rithm Capital Corp.
run.title: CP-OS host session (RITM)
run.summary: Neutral to cautious. A profitable mortgage servicing and origination core and demonstrated market access support the credit, but heavy near-term maturities, uncommitted funding lines and a structurally junior position for the unsecured notes dominate. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents excluding restricted cash of US$740.572m and restricted cash of consolidated entities of US$101.715m (10-Q Q3 page:44). Available financing of US$10,785.284m is uncommitted and collateral-dependent (10-Q Q3 page:57); it is not counted as undrawn committed facilities.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No indentures, committed-liquidity data, covenant levels or ratings were supplied, and no EBITDA is reported.
CP-1 main limitation: Committed undrawn capacity, covenant levels and the unencumbered-asset figure are not printed, so liquidity headroom and covenant headroom cannot be calculated.
